xrefdescription.para: FDC-01: SoftLabel creation with required fields.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that a SoftLabel can be constructed and all documented fields are accessible.
Verifies that a properly constructed DistillationConfig reports isValid().
Verifies that SoftLabel::toJson() and SoftLabel::fromJson() preserve all fields.

xrefdescription.para: FDC-04: Coordinator initial state — round 0, no submissions.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that a freshly constructed coordinator has currentRound()==0, submittedCount()==0, and no last round.
Verifies that after submitting labels and broadcasting, currentRound()==1 and lastRound() has a value.

xrefdescription.para: FDC-06: broadcastToStudents() throws when no labels submitted.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that calling broadcastToStudents() without prior submitSoftLabels() throws std::runtime_error.

xrefdescription.para: FDC-07: Registered student callback receives the broadcast round.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that registerStudent() works and the callback is invoked with the correct round number during broadcastToStudents().

xrefdescription.para: FDC-08: DP budget verification allows broadcast within budget.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that verifyPrivacyBudget() returns true after one round when max_rounds == 0 (unlimited budget).
Verifies that a policy gate returning false causes broadcastToStudents() to throw std::runtime_error.

xrefdescription.para: FDC-10: privacyBudgetRemaining() returns max for unlimited rounds.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that when max_rounds == 0, privacyBudgetRemaining() returns std::numeric_limits<double>::max().

xrefdescription.para: FDC-11: Multiple students all receive the broadcast.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that when three students are registered, all three receive the broadcast round.

xrefdescription.para: FDC-12: generateModelCard() captures round and DP metadata.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that after one broadcast, generateModelCard() returns a snapshot with rounds_completed == 1 and the correct dp_epsilon_per_round.

briefdescription.para: Focused unit tests for federated distillation coordination.

detaileddescription.para:
Tests the core distributed knowledge distillation paths against the actual production API surface:
SoftLabel creation and JSON round-trip
FederatedDistillationCoordinator lifecycle and round tracking
DP budget verification and privacy budget remaining
Policy gate blocking broadcast
Student registration and broadcast delivery
Target: Production readiness validation for distillation layer. Q3 2026 Hardening: policy-gated flows, DP enforcement, deterministic behavior.
